body: CHIEF DISPOSITION RECEIVED AND EXECUTING: all five proposed architecture choices approved. The post-design cohort refinement remains: Oregontrail and Baseball share one 113-person partition, receipt 45d879a8c201d8b4424ecf208969d4339295f2a48394248ff130a94d48f5ebd9, preventing cross-story participant leakage. Exact code paths are now reserved under bd-01M17MT2JC0TS46BH9RTYMEVQ7; implementation has begun.
